name: vipex-desktop
description: Vipex desktop shell for parcel operations and native integrations.
author: Vipex Co. LTD

scripts.build:vite: vite build --config vite.main.config.ts && vite build --config vite.preload.config.ts
scripts.make:windows: bun run build:vite && electron-builder --config electron-builder.config.cjs --win nsis --x64 --publish never
scripts.make:windows:test: bun run build:vite && electron-builder --config electron-builder.windows-test.config.cjs --win nsis --x64 --publish never
